programme.title: Batie Girl / 巴铁女孩
programme.desc: Lu You, a famous young Chinese female footballer, is struck by injury and that puts an end to her sports career. She is down into the dumps and comes to the droughty, poor and backward village in north Pakistan to escape from it, where she accidentally helps the little girls realize their football dreams and alters the course of the girls' miserable life - getting married at the age of 13. For Lu You, the kindness and innocence of the Pakistani girls gradually opens up her heart that's been long shut to the outside and revives her confidence to step up to life. In the end, new sources of water in the village are gotten through by the Chinese enterprises which offer assistance to the construction of Pakistan due to the effort of this Chinese girl, thus radically changing the predicament of poverty and backwardness here.

programme.desc: Two women suddenly arrive in this quiet town, their respective names are Zora and Li Hong. Under the assistance of Bao Yin, Zora not only finds her long-lost father, but also discovers love and a sense of returning home. Li Hong has struggled to adapt to the pastoral life, however due to the direct and indirect help of Bao Yin she finally adapts to her new surroundings and falls in love with the land. programme.title: Patrolman Bao Yin / 片警宝音
programme.desc: Two women suddenly arrive in this quiet town, their respective names are Zora and Li Hong. Under the assistance of Bao Yin, Zora not only finds her long-lost father, but also discovers love and a sense of returning home. Li Hong has struggled to adapt to the pastoral life, however due to the direct and indirect help of Bao Yin she finally adapts to her new surroundings and falls in love with the land. However, just as Li Hong's life is improving, she is unfortunately killed by gangsters. Bao Yin finds himself once again in pursuit of a murder case that appears seemingly hopeless.

Now Tess's new medication seems to be working as she and her mother move to a new town seeking a fresh start. As Tess adjusts to her new life, horrific visions begin appearing of a deceased local girl, Lucy, recently killed in a grisly car accident. Hallucinations and physical manifestations intensify as Lucy's haunted spirit inhabits Tess's mind, body and soul. A local priest fears that it is Lucy attempting to return by taking control of the troubled Tess, and suggests exorcism as the only way to drive the dead girl out and bring peace to both of these tortured young souls.

programme.desc: When an Olympic gold medalist boxer met a young boxer who falls victim to match fixing, he vows to start a boxing team at the school he teaches at and give his student a shot at the nationals.

programme.title: Salmokji: Whispering Water
programme.desc: After an unidentified figure appears in the footage of Salmokji Reservoir, producer Su-in leads her crew to reshoot the site, only to encounter something lurking in the deep, dark water...

programme.title: Gate
programme.desc: A group of five conspired for one last heist, yet secrets inside the vault are large enough to overthrow the country.

programme.title: Spiritwalker
programme.desc: A man loses memory and wakes up in a new body every 12 hours. In search of his identity, he met a woman who claims to know him.

programme.title: The Exclusive: Beat the Devil's Tattoo
programme.desc: When a journalist discovers that his exclusive story on a serial killer was based on false information, he fabricates more lies to cover his mistake.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: Yuna is a YouTuber who is invited to a party where she drinks and falls asleep. She is then trapped in the trunk. The kidnapper asks her to do a kidnap live-stream and beg for money...

programme.title: The Ghost Game
programme.desc: 6 students head to an underground reservoir and perform a necromancy ritual, but nothing seems to happen. Terror unfolds when the ritual becomes a deadly curse and threatens their lives...

programme.title: Usury Academy
programme.desc: Kang-jin is bullied as the lowest-ranking boy at school with no presence and money. He starts a business on private loans by chance and soon rises to the top of the school hierarchy.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Ep1
programme.desc: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Ep2
programme.desc: Set sail for New Zealand's Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Ep3
programme.desc: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealand's South Island, where one of the world's longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Ep4
programme.desc: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf, near Auckland, New Zealand, and explore a true paradise for ocean creatures.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Ep5
programme.desc: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Ep6
programme.desc: Travel to the Cook Islands, the destination of choice for 3,000 humpback whales ready to mate and raise their young.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Ep1
programme.desc: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Ep2
programme.desc: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koala's spaying surgery takes a scary turn.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Ep3
programme.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Ep4
programme.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Ep5
programme.desc: Juggle the demands of caring for sick koala joeys with vet Claire, then see what it takes to save a squirrel glider caught in barbed wire.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive Ep1

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive Ep2
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in.

programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast Ep1

programme.title: Wild Tales From the Farm Ep1

programme.title: Wild Tales From the Farm Ep2
programme.desc: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

programme.title: Wild Tales From the Farm Ep3
programme.desc: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

programme.title: Wild Tales From the Farm Ep4
programme.desc: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumn's final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead.

programme.title: Deep in the Heart

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Ep1

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Ep2

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Ep3

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Ep4

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Ep5
